description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - The meeting in View of Selecting a new vice chairman for the Vacated Vice Chairman's Position of Katunayaka Seeduwa U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a meeting to select a new Vice Chairman for the Katunayaka Seeduwa Urban Council, which falls under electoral processes for local authorities. The notice is made under specific sections of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, directly relating to electoral procedures and positions within local government bodies.
